newsitem.title: LEBANON: Palestinian militants vow attacks against Israel.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian militants vow attacks against Israel.

text.p: Palestinian Islamists vowed on Thursday to launch attacks against Israel in retaliation for a decision by the Jewish state to build homes for Jews in Arab East Jerusalem.
The Islamic Resistance Movement Hamas called for the escalation of "massive resistance" in response to what it called "a declaration of war against the Arab existence in Jerusalem".

"The decision to build settlements uncovers the Zionist objectives. Let massive resistance escalate in response to these measures," the group said in a statement faxed to an international news agency in Beirut.
"We view the settlers as fighters who were and will remain legitimate targets for all our strugglers," the group added.

The Islamic Revolutionary Army, a little known Palestinian faction opposed to the peace process, warned of immediate retaliation against the Israeli decision to build 6,500 houses for Jews in Jabal Abu Ghneim or Har Homa.
"We are forced to immediately retaliate on targets that will hurt the enemy," the group said in a statement distributed in Beirut.
"We declare to the Arab and international public opinion that our fighters in different areas will move to stop the aggression on Jerusalem whatever may be the consequences," the group added.
Israel's decision has sparked criticism from its key ally the United States and Palestinian warnings that it could unleash bloodshed.
Israel says all of Jerusalem is its capital. Palestinians consider Arab East Jerusalem, which Israel seized during the 1967 Middle East war, the capital of a future Palestinian state.
